summary: The comment emphasizes the importance of libraries as a free access point to the internet, arguing against tying E-Rate decisions to educational outcomes and suggesting that libraries should not be limited based on educational metrics.

claims.requested_action: Tie E-Rate decisions to educational outcomes
claims.argument: The comment argues against tying E-Rate decisions to educational outcomes, suggesting that libraries should not be limited based on educational metrics.
claims.evidence_quote: When I suddenly became unemployed I went to the library to submit job applications as well as upload all of my unemployment forms. I would not have been able to do that without the library and its free access to the internet.
